Healthy gums = Strong foundation for your teeth
📍 Visit 3A Dental Clinic, Girgaon for expert guidance on proper brushing techniques

Healthy habits = Healthy gums = Healthy smile 😁

featured_reviews.name: Jasmine Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review after completing my entire treatment at Dotiya Dental Clinic. I visited the clinic for a dental implant, which was a very complicated case. Several other dentists had advised against proceeding with the implant, but Dr. Aditya Dotiya confidently took up my case.
Since childhood, I have rarely changed dentists, so choosing a new one was not easy for me. However, Dr. Aditya’s professionalism, kindness, and patience made the entire experience extremely comfortable. He patiently answered all my questions—even the ones I felt were repetitive or unnecessary—always with politeness and clarity.
The surgery was performed about six months ago, followed by regular monthly check-ups and scans to monitor the healing process. Today, my final implant was successfully completed, and I am extremely happy with the results.
What impressed me the most was how smooth and painless the entire process felt. Even while sitting on the dental chair, I hardly realized that the procedure was happening. Dr. Aditya’s skill and gentle approach truly make a difference.
I am very grateful to have been treated by such a dedicated and skilled doctor. I highly recommend Dotiya Dental Clinic to anyone looking for expert and compassionate dental care.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
